segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You kneel near the giant iron shaft in the center of the floor. You brush away the thick dust with your boot. The wooden planks aren't nailed down in straight lines—they're carved in concentric circles, like the face of an enormous wooden clock! Roman numerals are carved into the timber, from I to XII... and right at the bottom, an impossible numeral: XIII.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: The floor is a clock dial!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip shouts back, grabbing the stove rod.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: It just needed the master ignition engage-lever!
